headline: Mercy Ships Returns to Ghana After 19 Years
meta_description: After nearly two decades, Mercy Ships' hospital ship is back in Ghana to deliver free surgeries and dental care while training local healthcare workers.
summary_short: Mercy Ships has returned to Ghana after 19 years with its hospital ship, ready to transform healthcare access across the West African nation.
body:
After 19 years away, Mercy Ships has returned to Ghana with its hospital ship, bringing free surgical care and dental treatment to communities with limited access to healthcare.

The organization plans to provide up to 2,600 free surgeries and 2,000 dental treatments during its time in the country. Beyond immediate patient care, the mission carries a deeper purpose: training hundreds of Ghanaian healthcare professionals who will continue this work long after the ship departs.

The return represents a significant moment for healthcare expansion in West Africa, where access to surgical services remains uneven. By combining direct care with local professional development, Mercy Ships is working to build lasting capacity within Ghana's own medical system—ensuring that the impact extends far beyond the ship's visit.
quick_facts: Mercy Ships returns to Ghana after 19-year absence
Up to 2,600 free surgeries planned during mission
Hundreds of Ghanaian healthcare professionals to receive training
